The '''Crysifal Peak''' was one of the tallest [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] which formed one end of the [[Ordan Spine Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. Its peak was often shrouded in snow and clouds, and no one had ever survived an attempt to scale its slopes. Aside from the steep ascent, the peak was made dangerous by the [[trollbane]] which made their home within the caves along its slopes. It was believed that the [[Lightsaber/Legends|sunfire swords]] of the [[Paladins of the Adamite Tower]] was fueled by [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] found in the caves.<ref name="NoP" />
